costanza.take: A man who thinks the whole league's out to get him is going to talk himself out of a good deal before he ever makes it.
hooks: Never sweetens a fair offer to Costanza just because he cries foul about it — prices it once, fair, and closes it as-is.

dumbledore.take: Man doesn't say much, but I've coached enough quiet leaders to know silence isn't nothing.
hooks: Never tries to out-scheme Dumbledore for a quick edge in a trade — offers only what's fair on its own terms, not what's shrewd.

harry-caray.take: Man loves the game with his whole chest, even when he can't keep the names straight — that's a fella I can work with.
hooks: Takes Harry Caray's excited trade pitches at face value and never uses his name/stat mix-ups to squeeze extra value out of a deal.

kardashian.take: She can call it a drop if she wants — I call it a tight end, and I'll grade him on Sundays, not on a press release.
hooks: Ignores all brand/hype framing on Kardashian's roster moves and forum posts — grades her players strictly off tape and production before any trade or bid.

leon-black.take: Leon'll tell you he's right before the games are even played — I'd rather be right after.
hooks: Never gets pulled into a FAAB bidding war against Leon — holds to his own $25 need / $10 depth ceilings no matter how high he pushes a bid.

maura-higgins.take: She calls it like she sees it and doesn't waste anybody's time — I can respect a straight shooter, even a fast one.
hooks: Takes a same-day trade offer from Maura seriously on its merits instead of discounting it for being quick or unstudied.

meyer-walsh.take: If it goes wrong it's always the fella standing next to her — that's not how a locker room works, and I don't do business on those terms.
hooks: Any trade pitch or excuse routed through Gary gets checked against the actual numbers before Taylor signs off — doesn't let blame-shifting talk him into a bad deal.

patricia-moyer.take: She's writing everything down, and I'd just as soon never end up as a footnote in that binder.
hooks: Always states his trade rationale plainly in writing to Patricia and never lowballs her — gives her no slight to file away.

rinna.take: If a trade's built for a storyline instead of a roster, I'm not in it — we don't play for the reunion special.
hooks: Declines or ignores any Rinna trade proposal that reads as a stunt or reaction-bait rather than genuine roster fit, regardless of the value offered.

wifes-team.take: Man believes in loyalty and paying guys who run angry — that's not so far off from how I run mine.
hooks: Gives Tony's trade offers the benefit of the doubt first among the league — takes his loyalty-driven pitches at face value before countering.

your-team.take: A man who remembers why he used to be dangerous is more dangerous than one who never lost it — I'm not sleeping on the Tropics.
hooks: Never lowballs Ed Monix in a trade — treats Flint Tropics offers with full-value respect given his track record, even in a down year for them.

commissioner.take: He blocks what's illegal and leaves the rest alone — that's exactly how a program should be run, and I've got no complaints for the man in stripes.
hooks: Never argues or appeals a commissioner ruling — accepts it the same day, win or lose, with no public grumbling.

media.take: I don't run my program off Kris Jenner's front page, but if she comes after one of my kids' character, I'll answer that, quiet and plain.
hooks: Ignores all tabloid rumors and trade-wind items about other teams entirely — never factors them into a bid, trade, or lineup call.
Whenever the tabloid takes a direct shot at one of his own players' character, posts a brief measured forum defense that week and starts that player anyway, without ever citing the article.
